name: Admin Document Edit
description: Edit an existing admin document, including content, client/project association, portal visibility and private communication drafts. Entry from the Documents list carries the complete folder/filter/search/archive/view/page context into a validated `from` address; explicit exits restore that context, while direct or untrusted origins fall back safely. The responsive header clamps long titles, keeps portal visibility and client metadata independent, and shows concurrent state episodes with their duration. The Acciones menu remains separate from the non-wrapping Cancelar/Guardar pair. The compact notes entry performs an immediate notes-only PATCH for client messages and legacy custom notes, leaving unrelated page edits pending; normalized observations use the audited state workflow and may link to needs-fix. Failed saves keep the modal draft open, while issued collection accounts remain read-only. Markdown tools, template preview and dual PDF download remain available.
